Dear Miss Yonge,
[I](../persons.html#939) was from home when your note about Index & [Miss Sewell](../persons.html#1606)’s suggestion of a chronological table came to hand.[^1] But I have not been neglecting the suggestion.

We are having a set of proofs made & shall put them into the hands of a competent person and submit the proofs to you.

With regard to announcing volume 3 [Next few lines illegible] the printers want something to do [illegible] and long and we have set them to work on the [Chaplet of Pearls](../books.html#69).

You need not worry youself with this connection.

Your story will end I suppose about October & we should publish about the same time.[^2]
I was sorry to miss you when you were in town.

Yours very faithfully
A.

Macmillan

[^1]: These were for the [Historical Selections](../books.html#71) compiled by CMY and Elizabeth Sewell.

[^2]: The Chaplet of Pearls was being serialized in [MP](../others.html#52).
